meta.title: Sidebar icon theme
meta.description: Claymorphism sidebar icons: 21 soft-clay folders for Workspace rows (matched from the directory name) and 28 soft-clay objects for Session rows (matched from the title), all sharing one light source. A new project never repeats the colour above it, any row can be re-iconed from its own ⋯ menu, and Session rows are indented under their project with a hairline guide.
